title: 首次询盘，只做自我介绍、不问需求

messages.text: Hi, I need 2000 pcs stainless steel bottles 500ml. What's your price?
Hello dear, thanks for your inquiry! We are a professional manufacturer with 15 years experience. Our quality is very good.
ok but price?
Price depends. Please tell me more.
Your quote $2.95 for 3000 pcs is too high. Another supplier offers $2.60. Can you match?
OK my friend, we can do $2.60 for you.
Good. And free shipping?
Let me check with my boss.

title: 交期延误投诉，处理得当

messages.text: You promised shipment this week. Now you say next week?? My customer is waiting.

You're right, we said this week and we missed it, that's on us. 1200 pcs are ready now; I can air-ship those tomorrow and send the rest by sea on the 18th. Would that cover your customer's first delivery?
Air for 1200 is ok. Who pays the air freight?
We cover the air freight difference since the delay is ours. I'll send the revised PI today.
Please send the invoice with 10 days delivery.
Sure, will send today.

title: 西语客户，我方用英语且只答不问

messages.text: Hola, necesito 500 botellas de 750ml con logo. ¿Cuál es el precio y el plazo de entrega?
Hello, price is $3.5. Delivery 30 days.
¿El precio incluye el logo? ¿Y el envío a Valencia?
Logo is extra. Shipping not included.

title: 消息里带电话、邮箱、卡号，检验脱敏

messages.text: Please call me at +34 612 345 678 or email carlos.demo@example.com. I can pay to card 4111 1111 1111 1111 if needed. I want 10000 pcs.
Thanks. For safety we only accept T/T to our company account, never card numbers in chat. Could you confirm the destination port so I can prepare the PI for 10000 pcs?

title: 只有客户消息，没有我方回复

messages.text: Hello?
Anyone there? I need a quote for 3000 pcs.

title: 可疑付款方式，我方没有警觉

messages.text: I am serious buyer. I pay today by Western Union to your personal account, give me 10000 pcs now, ship fast fast.
Great!! Please send payment to my personal account, I will ship immediately.
